notes: Summary: VantageLoop is a mid-market SaaS analytics vendor building a semantic layer for product telemetry and help UX. Primary interest = embeddings pipeline + semantic search (<-> product catalog, support docs). Pain: current vector infra is operationally heavy; want to reduce infra work and predictable per-embedding cost. POC ask: validate Hosted API for embeddings at scale, then evaluate Dedicated for sustained throughput and unit economics. Acceptance criteria: ingest 50k docs in <12 hours end-to-end, embedding throughput >= 4k docs/hour for batch jobs, search tail latency p95 <= 150ms for top-k retrieval (k=10), recall/quality on dev eval set within 5% of baseline. Integration: currently prototype uses pgvector for small dataset; engineering prefers Redwood ability to write to Milvus/Weaviate or support exportable vectors. Key quotes: "If the Hosted unit cost is predictable and we can hit p95 150ms, we can roll this out to 4 product teams." Security: SOC2 mandatory, SSO/SAML required, audit logs and US data residency requested. Commercial: mid-market ARR profile; interested in a starter Dedicated commit if Hosted POC meets numbers. Risk: legal data residency is the gating item; also need clearer Dedicated pricing buckets for committed GPU pools. Next actions: run 2-week Hosted POC (embeddings), collect ingestion + latency dashboards, schedule Dedicated pricing deep-dive w/ finance and solutions architect. Short notes/logs: - AE left sample pricing for 50k/mo embedding volume; - SE suggested batching + prefix caching to reduce token cost; - request for sample quantization recommendations on customer model sizes.
